## Library Clusters {#topic-library-map .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="section-card-grid">
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Open Here</span>
    <h3>Remote Sensing</h3>
    <p>Sensor physics, retrieval logic, orbit geometry, and specialist observation systems live here as one coherent branch.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Or Here</span>
    <h3>Cryosphere and Mountains</h3>
    <p>Snow, glaciers, permafrost, and alpine hazards form a field-focused branch with strong internal identity.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Methods Branch</span>
    <h3>Machine Learning</h3>
    <p>Regression, dimensionality reduction, and quantitative depth appear here when readers are ready for later-stage methods.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Deep Cuts</span>
    <h3>Environmental and Economic Extensions</h3>
    <p>Biogeochemical depth, severe-weather chapters, and larger infrastructure systems round out the branch library.</p>
  </article>
</div>
```
